name: Comet at the Caravanserai
image_style: Textured egg-tempera and mineral-pigment illustration on dark vellum, combining precise medieval astronomical diagramming with softly weathered gouache, restrained hatching, and subtly luminous night atmosphere. The mood is contemplative, chivalric, quietly humorous, and historically grounded. Use a nontraditional palette of deep blue-green shadow, parchment-ivory highlights, oxidized coral, muted brass, and sparse icy turquoise accents. Keep forms crisp enough for desktop viewing, with broad atmospheric negative space and a calm, nearly unmarked upper edge; no lettering, borders, logos, or decorative UI.
scene: A single striking 16:10 landscape wallpaper set at dusk beside a historically grounded medieval caravanserai on a high desert trade route. A small stone astronomical platform, weathered wooden instruments, tethered pack horses, and a distant fortified hospice establish the setting with reverence and realism. In the lower-right foreground, Space Ghost appears as an unmistakable out-of-place visitor—muscular white costume, black hood and mask, yellow cape, red power bands—standing stiffly and respectfully while holding an oversized brass astrolabe as though on official duty. A few robed scholars quietly continue their star measurements nearby, treating him as an awkward but harmless colleague. A comet crosses the open sky, guiding the composition toward the empty upper-left region reserved for desktop widgets. The humor comes only from his solemn scientific posture and conspicuous costume; no sacred figures, devotional objects, worship, lettering, or explanatory text.
